annotations.title: Kalshi Perp Liquidation — where a leveraged position gets closed out

description: Use for "where does a 5x bitcoin long liquidate on Kalshi". Estimates a Kalshi perp's liquidation price and the % move to it from Kalshi's risk parameters (a 5x BTC long is about 8% away, not the 20% the 100÷leverage rule implies), plus fees and expected funding. An estimate; Kalshi's app shows the exact one. Assets: btc, eth, sol, xrp, doge, hype, link, gold, silver, platinum, palladium. Free.

asset.description: The perp. One of: btc · eth · sol · xrp · doge · hype · link · gold · silver · platinum · palladium.

entry.description: Entry price (default: the live price). Accepts a number or a numeric string ("+150", "62%", "2.5").

hold_days.description: Days held, for the funding estimate (default 7).

leverage.description: Leverage, e.g. 5 or "5x". Capped at Kalshi’s maximum for the size and side.

margin.description: Margin in dollars (default 1000). Accepts a number or a numeric string ("+150", "62%", "2.5").
